relevance.rationale: Establishes WKB ideal triangulations of Riemann surfaces with quadratic differentials and proves flips across BPS Stokes walls induce Kontsevich-Soibelman / dilogarithm cluster symplectomorphisms.

keyResults.statement: Across BPS walls in parameter space, WKB triangulations undergo flips and pops whose Fock-Goncharov Darboux coordinates transform by dilogarithm symplectomorphisms governed by the invariant spectrum generator.
keyResults.useForFolio: Connects Riemann-surface WKB foliations to ideal-triangulation flips and non-abelian Stokes / pentagon wall-crossing.
